libOverrides.css-fallback.mjs: Embr ships styles.css/preset.css/tokens.css as a relative-import chain (scripts/build-css.js), and none of the three contain compiled Tailwind utility classes — the preset is the shipped artefact, utilities are generated by the consuming app's own Tailwind build (docs/adr/0003). The only place fully-compiled CSS exists is the reference storybook build, so the fallback needs to fire even though dist/styles.css isn't a tiny stub.
